[[File:Alan Shearer 2008.jpg|thumb|upright|[[Alan Shearer]] was the first player to score 200 Premier League goals, and is the only player to score 100 goals for two clubs.]]

A total of 35 players have scored 100 or more goals in the [[Premier League]] since the league's formation.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.premierleague.com/en/stats/top/players?statMetric=goals&season=all|title=Premier League Player Stats – Goals|work=Premier League|access-date=15 September 2025}}</ref> These players have been collectively referred to as the ''100 Club''.<ref>{{cite news |last=Rice |first=Simon |url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/news/100-club-most-prolific-scorers-premier-league-1918267.html |title=100 club: The most prolific scorers in the Premier League |work=[[The Independent]] |date=8 March 2010 |access-date=20 October 2021 |archive-date=14 March 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230314233639/https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/news/100-club-most-prolific-scorers-premier-league-1918267.html |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last=Wright |first=Chris |url=https://www.espn.co.uk/football/blog-the-toe-poke/story/4475751/will-manesterlingronaldo-follow-salah-as-next-player-to-join-premier-leagues-100-club |title=Will Mane, Sterling, Ronaldo follow Salah as next player to join Premier League's 100 Club? |publisher=[[ESPN]] |date=17 September 2021 |access-date=20 October 2021 |archive-date=19 March 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230319020850/https://www.espn.co.uk/football/blog-the-toe-poke/story/4475751/will-manesterlingronaldo-follow-salah-as-next-player-to-join-premier-leagues-100-club |url-status=live }}</ref> This list excludes goals from the [[Football League First Division]] (1888–1992), showing only those scored in the Premier League since its inception in the [[1992–93 FA Premier League|1992–93 season]]. [[Alan Shearer]] holds the record for the most goals scored in the Premier League, with 260, and was the first player to reach 100 goals, having achieved the feat in 124 games.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.fourfourtwo.com/features/alan-shearer-premier-league-record-goalscorer-hall-of-fame-underrated-newcastle-blackburn|title=Alan Shearer: Is the all-time Premier League record goalscorer actually underrated?|first=Richard|last=Jolly|date=26 April 2021|website=FourFourTwo|accessdate=24 March 2022|archive-date=15 March 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230315010602/https://www.fourfourtwo.com/features/alan-shearer-premier-league-record-goalscorer-hall-of-fame-underrated-newcastle-blackburn|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.themag.co.uk/2018/02/harry-kane-fails-beat-alan-shearers-record-4-newcastle-players-total-feature-premier-league-100-club-newcastle-united/|title=Harry Kane fails to beat Alan Shearer's record - 4 Newcastle players in total feature in Premier League 100 club|last=Smithfield|first=Jackie|date=6 February 2018|website=NUFC The Mag|accessdate=24 March 2022|archive-date=14 March 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230314180421/https://www.themag.co.uk/2018/02/harry-kane-fails-beat-alan-shearers-record-4-newcastle-players-total-feature-premier-league-100-club-newcastle-united/|url-status=live}}</ref> Along with Shearer, [[Harry Kane]] and [[Wayne Rooney]] are the only players to score 200 or more goals.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Mendola |first=Nicholas |date=7 January 2026 |title=Premier League all-time goal leaders — Haaland passes Drogba; Salah chasing Rooney, Kane |url=https://www.nbcsports.com/soccer/news/premier-league-all-time-goal-leaders-harry-kane-wayne-rooney-alan-shearer |url-status=live |access-date=16 January 2026 |website=[[NBC Sports]]}}</ref> 

[[Erling Haaland]] became the most recent player to score 100 goals in December 2025, doing so in just 111 appearances, making him the fastest player to reach the milestone.<ref>{{cite web |date=2 December 2025 |title=Haaland joins the Premier League's 100 Club in record time |url=https://www.premierleague.com/en/news/4455995/erling-haaland-scores-100th-premier-league-goal-in-record-number-of-matches |publisher=Premier League}}</ref> [[Michael Owen]] is the youngest player to score 100 goals at 23 years, 133 days.<ref>{{cite web |title=Lukaku joins the 100 club at record age |url=https://www.premierleague.com/news/654769 |work=Premier League |date=2 April 2018 |access-date=5 June 2020 |archive-date=14 March 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230314205641/https://www.premierleague.com/news/654769 |url-status=live}}</ref> [[Dwight Yorke]] was the first non-English player to reach 100 in November 2000.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://theanalyst.com/2025/02/fastest-premier-league-goals |title=Fastest Premier League Goals: Top 10 |author=Opta Analyst |date=1 February 2025 |work=The Analyst |accessdate=16 March 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/0261-107d82d75d76-8f0e9280f586-1000--how-brilliant-was-chelsea-s-final-master-didier-drogba/ |title=How brilliant was Chelsea's final master Didier Drogba? |date=29 September 2020 |website=[[UEFA]] |access-date=25 January 2025}}</ref> [[Mohamed Salah]] is the highest scoring foreign player in Premier League history. [[Didier Drogba]] became the first African to hit 100 goals in March 2012.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2012/mar/10/chelsea-stoke-city-premier-league|title=Didier Drogba's neat finish gives Chelsea victory against Stoke City|first=David|last=Hytner|date=10 March 2012|work=The Guardian|access-date=17 August 2025|quote=The Ivorian's first touch looked heavy but his second took him around the Stoke goalkeeper Asmir Begovic. His third brought up his 100th Premier League goal and saw him become the first African player to reach the landmark.}}</ref> In April 2016, [[Sergio Agüero]] became the first South American to hit the 100 mark, and [[Son Heung-min]] became the first Asian player to do so in April 2023.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/international-football/2016/04/19/57169cba268e3e7d338b45f8.html|title=Aguero reaches 100 Premier League goals|last=Panero|first=Daniel|date=19 April 2016|website=MARCA English|access-date=25 January 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Benson |first=Michael |url=https://talksport.com/football/1388367/heung-min-son-premier-league-100-club-tottenham/ |title=Heung-min Son makes history as screamer for Tottenham puts him in Premier League 100 club |date=8 April 2023 |work=Talksport |access-date=8 April 2023 |archive-date=8 April 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230408144120/https://talksport.com/football/1388367/heung-min-son-premier-league-100-club-tottenham/ |url-status=live }}</ref>  Six of the 35 players reached 100 without scoring a penalty: [[Sadio Mané]], [[Peter Crouch]], [[Emile Heskey]], [[Les Ferdinand]], [[Andy Cole]],<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.planetfootball.com/quick-reads/comparing-liverpool-sadio-manes-goal-record-to-other-no-penalty-pl-centurions/ |title=Comparing Sadio Mane's goal record to other no-penalty PL centurions |date=19 October 2021 |access-date=25 October 2021 |work=Planet Football |archive-date=25 October 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211025160605/https://www.planetfootball.com/quick-reads/comparing-liverpool-sadio-manes-goal-record-to-other-no-penalty-pl-centurions/ |url-status=live }}</ref> and [[Ryan Giggs]].<ref>{{cite news |last=Dawson |first=Alan |url=https://www.goal.com/en/news/9/english-football/2009/11/28/1653550/portsmouth-1-4-manchester-united-giggs-scores-100th-premier |title=Portsmouth 1-4 Manchester United: Giggs Scores 100th Premier League Goal |date=28 November 2009 |work=Goal.com|access-date=18 January 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210730182049/https://www.goal.com/en/news/9/english-football/2009/11/28/1653550/portsmouth-1-4-manchester-united-giggs-scores-100th-premier|archive-date=30 July 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2010/04/26/sports/soccer/26iht-CUP.html|title=At 36, Giggs Finally Scores His First Penalties|work=[[The New York Times]]|date=25 April 2010|access-date=18 January 2022|archive-date=18 January 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220118194406/https://www.nytimes.com/2010/04/26/sports/soccer/26iht-CUP.html|url-status=live}}</ref>{{Efn|Giggs scored two penalties in the Premier League, both after he had already achieved 100 goals.|name=l}}

Of players currently active in the Premier League, [[Callum Wilson]] and [[Chris Wood (footballer, born 1991)|Chris Wood]] are the closest to joining the list with 95 and 92 goals, respectively.<ref>{{cite web |title=Callum Wilson Brentford Forward, Profile & Stats |url= https://www.premierleague.com/en/players/75115/callum-wilson/overview |access-date=23 July 2026 |publisher=Premier League}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Chris Wood Nottingham Forest Forward, Profile & Stats |url=https://www.premierleague.com/en/players/60689/chris-wood/overview |access-date=3 February 2025 |publisher=Premier League}}</ref>
